map.→ 打开「复利计算器」工具立即使用: -> Open the compound interest calculator tool and start now
map.单利只对本金计息，复利对\"本金+已生利息\"再计息，长期差距巨大。: Simple interest accrues on the principal only, while compound interest accrues on "principal plus interest already earned", so the gap over time is enormous.
map.单笔本金复利未来值计算: Compound interest future value of a single principal
map.可调年化利率与计息频次: Adjustable annual interest rate and compounding frequency
map.填写年化收益率与年限: Enter the annual yield and the number of years
map.复利和单利差在哪？: Where do compound and simple interest differ?
map.复利被称为\"世界第八大奇迹\"。ToolBox 复利计算器在本地帮你测算一笔本: Compound interest is called the "eighth wonder of the world". The ToolBox compound interest calculator computes locally the future value of a sum under periodic compounding and regular investment, so you can see the power of time and rates.
map.定投和单笔哪个好？: Regular investment or a single lump sum?
map.定投平摊时点风险，适合工资结余；单笔适合已有本金。: Regular investment spreads out timing risk and suits salary surpluses; a lump sum suits existing principal.
map.支持每月/每年定投（年金）: Supports monthly and yearly regular investment (annuity)
map.教育金、养老金长期测算: Long-range projection for education funds and pensions
map.时间是复利最大变量，越早开始收益越显著: Time is the largest variable in compound interest; the earlier you start, the larger the gain
map.比较不同利率/期限下的收益: Compare returns under different rates and terms
map.注意\"年化\"与\"实际到手\"的差异，税费会侵蚀收益: Note the difference between "annualised" and "actual take-home", since tax and fees erode returns
map.点击计算，查看未来值与利息: Click calculate to see the future value and interest
map.理解\"尽早开始\"的复利效应: Understand the compound interest effect of "starting early"
map.用曲线观察增长加速点: Use curves to observe the acceleration point of growth
map.输出本金、利息、总额明细: Output the principal, interest and total
map.选择是否定投及金额/频率: Choose whether to make regular investments and the amount/frequency
map.高收益常伴高风险，计算器不含波动: High returns come with high risk; the calculator excludes volatility
